decks.notes: The deck focuses on using various card manipulation spells and combo pieces to quickly assemble and win with the Doomsday combo. It includes cards like Demonic Consultation, Street Wraith, and Doomsday to set up a winning pile using Thassa's Oracle. The deck also includes powerful disruption cards like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect the combo. The key strategy is to quickly assemble the combo pieces, resolve Doomsday, and win the game on the same turn before the opponent can disrupt the plan.

This deck focuses on rapidly filling the graveyard with creatures like Basking Rootwalla and Bloodghast to fuel the powerful recursion abilities of Vengevine and Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis. By utilizing cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Stitcher's Supplier, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with aggressive creatures like Hollow One and Blazing Rootwalla. The inclusion of disruptive spells like Force of Vigor and Chalice of the Void helps to control the board while the deck sets up its explosive creature chains. The key strategy is to efficiently leverage graveyard resources to create a fast, aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on using the powerful combo of Underworld Breach and cards like Black Lotus, Time Walk, and Brain Freeze to generate infinite loops and win the game quickly. It includes powerful tutors like Demonic Tutor and Vampiric Tutor to find key combo pieces, as well as disruption in the form of Force of Will and Pyroblast to protect the combo. The deck also includes cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Opposition Agent to disrupt the opponent's strategies and control the game. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent.

This Vintage 1 vs 1 deck focuses on using control elements and strategically manipulating artifacts to gain advantage over opponents. It utilizes cards like Tinker, Time Vault, and various Mox cards to generate mana quickly and disrupt opponents' strategies. The inclusion of cards like Goblin Engineer and Engineer Control allows for efficient artifact tutoring and manipulation. The deck aims to control the board state while leveraging its artifact synergies to create overwhelming advantage and secure victory.

This deck focuses on using powerful control cards and utility lands to disrupt opponents while generating advantage through card draw and efficient spells. It aims to control the game by countering threats, removing key permanents, and eventually locking the opponent out of the game using time-related combos or mana denial strategies. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Sphinx of the Steel Wind and Monastery Mentor to close out games once control has been established. Overall, this deck is designed to outmaneuver and outlast opponents in a grindy control matchup.

This Vintage 1 vs 1 Aggro - Azorius Tempo deck focuses on quickly establishing board control and tempo advantage through the use of powerful mana accelerants like the Moxen, along with efficient counterspells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm. The deck also includes powerful card advantage engines like Narset, Parter of Veils and Sphinx of the Steel Wind, as well as disruptive creatures like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade. By efficiently disrupting the opponent's game plan while developing its own threats, this deck seeks to win the game through a combination of card advantage and tempo advantage.

This deck focuses on using various control elements such as counterspells, card draw, and disruptive creatures to maintain board control and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It aims to combo off with cards like Underworld Breach, Bolas's Citadel, and Time Vault to generate a powerful advantage and win the game quickly. The deck also includes powerful mana acceleration through the use of Moxes and artifact lands, allowing it to quickly deploy threats and answer opposing plays efficiently. Overall, the deck is designed to dominate the game through powerful synergies and precise decision-making.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifact synergy and fast mana acceleration to ramp up quickly and combo off with Coveted Jewel. It includes powerful cards like Tolarian Academy, Grim Monolith, and Mishra's Workshop to generate mana quickly. The deck also includes multiple ways to tutor for key combo pieces like Tinker and Trinisphere. By leveraging powerful artifacts and spells like Force of Will and Paradoxical Outcome, the deck aims to establish a strong board presence and win the game through overwhelming card advantage and mana ramp.
